title: Tasty Humans
description: Datapack that makes players, villagers and pillagers drop porkchop!
body:
Datapack that makes players, villagers and pillagers drop porkchop!

players drop 0-2 pork
villagers 1-3 pork
pillagers 0-1 pork
wandering traders 1-4 pork


Balance may be bad for vanilla, if so, change loot tables yourself.
